🌟 LiveAvatar | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Real-time generation of long, interactive avatar videos driven by audio input.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time streaming interaction (45 FPS) • Infinite-length autoregressive generation (10,000+ seconds) • Audio-driven avatar generation • High generalization performance across diverse characters and scenarios • FP8 quantization for performance breakthrough
📖 Summary: Live Avatar is a framework for generating real-time, streaming, and infinitely long audio-driven avatar videos. It utilizes a large diffusion model and block-wise autoregressive processing to achieve high frame rates and support extended video generation.
